# Purple Roots Agency

> Purple Roots Agency is a cinema-grade video production and creative marketing agency based in El Paso, Texas. It starts with a full business audit that shows an owner where customers are being lost, then builds the attention engine (cinematic and comedic short-form content) and the software systems behind the client's own website that help the business run and keep those customers. AI content and paid ads scale what works.

## Services

Spanish versions of each service page live under https://purpleroots.agency/es/

- Business audit: a full review of social media, website, Google presence and reviews, the offer, and lead handling, delivered as a plain written list of where customers are lost and what to fix first. Details: https://purpleroots.agency/audit
- Research and strategy: market, audience, and competitor research before any creative work
- Brand identity: logos, visual systems, brand voice, and rebrands. Details: https://purpleroots.agency/brand-identity-el-paso
- Video production: cinematic brand films, commercials, short-form video for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and comedy content. Details: https://purpleroots.agency/video-production-el-paso
- Social media and community: content calendars, posting, and community management. Details: https://purpleroots.agency/social-media-marketing-el-paso
- Web design: websites and landing pages built to convert. Details: https://purpleroots.agency/web-design-el-paso
- Software and web development: custom websites, web apps, e-commerce and product builders, payments and memberships (Stripe, Authorize.net), customer portals, admin dashboards and integrations, frontend and backend. Details: https://purpleroots.agency/software-development-el-paso
- Business systems: employee backends and admin portals built on the client's own website domain
- AI content: AI video and content for faster output and more testing
- Paid amplification: Meta ads placed behind content that already works organically

## Method

Purple Roots follows an "attention first" method: (1) research the market, (2) earn attention with creative content, (3) build community, (4) amplify proven content with paid ads.

## Proof and case studies

- Tippin Cowgirl (El Paso western boutique and hat bar): 6,500+ new followers and 1.5M+ views in 60 days, grand-opening campaign for their first Hat Bar
- El Toro Law / Mario Yague (personal injury attorney): $700K+ in client revenue in 4 months, fully organic, with $0 spent on paid ads, from brand identity, a new website, social content, and community strategy
- Powerhouse Gym (El Paso): $70,000 in membership revenue and 80 memberships sold from one commercial with $1,500 in paid ads
- Mark Davis (personal brand): 557,000 views and 402 inbound calls from one commercial
- Chingon Cuh'ts (barbershop): 500,000 views from $100 in ad spend; record walk-ins and appointments
- The agency states its content formula has generated 700M+ organic views across client work

## Software built by Purple Roots

- Torque Baseball (El Paso baseball and softball academy, torquebaseball.us): membership and payments platform with recurring Stripe billing, digital waivers, QR check-in in real time, events and RSVPs, and an owner dashboard; bilingual EN/ES public site
- Tippin' Cowgirl (El Paso Hat Bar, tippincowgirl.com): online store with a visual custom hat builder, live pricing and Stripe checkout
- Molon Labe Firearms (licensed firearms dealer in El Paso, molonlabeguns.com): showroom and sales platform with a first-person intro game, 21+ age gate, inventory and limited drops, Authorize.net payments and an owner admin portal

## Ideal client

Local and regional businesses (law firms, medical practices, auto dealers, gyms, restaurants, retailers, homebuilders) that want video-led marketing which produces measurable revenue, not just views.
